# اِعْتَذَرْتَ (iʕtaḏarta) /iʕ.ta.ðar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# اِعْتَذَرْتِ (iʕtaḏarti) /iʕ.ta.ðar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# اِعْتَذَرَتْ (iʕtaḏarat) /iʕ.ta.ða.rat/: third-perso
